Not worth the hype!
Nov 2024 • Family
The good
- I had gone for the jazz night on Friday. The band and the singers were fantastic! Infact that’s the only reason why one would go there, they brought life and vibe to the place.

The bad
- I had to wait for 25 whole minutes for my drinks to be served. The person next to me finished his freshly served drink and ordered a new one in the mean time. When questioned at the 20th minute I was told the drink is made in a step-by-step manner. No apology, no promptness or realisation that they completely forgot about my drink 
- I had heard great things about the place and as someone who loves to try cocktails all the time I was soooo disappointed. I had to take a sip of water after every sip of the drink to actually drink it. The drink was potent but tasteless. Lacked the tropical touch and pineapple flavours it mentioned. My moms drink was just fine
- While the music was fantastic it was blaring right in my ears. I’d come to enjoy a fun jazz night not a blasting EDM episode where I can’t talk to the person I’ve come with
- The place is too cramped, the staff is constantly shuffling
- I had to pay an extra fee for the jazz night which was new to me. I’d confirmed outside if this was an entry fee that would get adjusted with my bill for drinks and I was told it would. Unfortunately, I was charged additionally at a bar to enjoy the music there, which was a first for me!

All in all, waste of my time and money for my one night to step out and enjoy at Da Nang.

I’m sure this must one of the bad days for them but it definitely doesn’t get considered for a tourist having limited time in a city to make it memorable.
